summary.text: John Bartlett is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 95 who has represented the district since 2008 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a retired tool-and-die maker and previously served as minority caucus chair.

paragraphs.text: Bartlett graduated from Arsenal Technical High School and Martin University and also attended Ivy Tech.
He worked as a tool-and-die maker for the Rolls-Royce Corporation for 42 years before retiring.

He began his political career as a precinct committeeman, then served on the mayor's Neighborhood Advisory Council and the Judicial Nominations Commission under Governor Frank O'Bannon, and was appointed to the Public Compensation Advisory Commission by former House Speaker Pat Bauer.
He took office in the Indiana House in 2008 and previously served as minority caucus chair.
